review_candidates.title: Executive & Personal Assistant to the CEO
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and trustworthy Executive Assistant to work directly with the CEO of multiple U.S.-based businesses operating in healthcare, business consulting, and professional development. This is more than a traditional administrative position. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable right hand to the CEO, helping manage daily responsibilities, coordinate projects, follow up on priorities, and ensure that important tasks are completed efficiently. The ideal candidate is someone who takes initiative, anticipates needs, solves problems independently, and thrives in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. Key Responsibilities Executive & Administrative Support - Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and scheduling across multiple businesses. - Organize emails, correspondence, reminders, and daily priorities. - Coordinate travel arrangements, reservations, and itineraries. - Prepare meeting agendas, documents, presentations, and executive summaries. - Maintain organized records, files, and confidential information. Project Management & Follow-Up - Track ongoing projects, deadlines, and action items across multiple companies. - Communicate with managers, team members, and external partners to ensure timely follow-up. - Monitor progress on assigned initiatives and provide regular updates. - Help organize priorities and ensure that commitments are not overlooked. - Identify potential delays and proactively recommend solutions. Business Growth & Special Projects - Support business development, marketing initiatives, and new business ventures. - Assist with organizing content creation, social media schedules, events, and business meetings. - Conduct research, gather information, and prepare reports. - Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and business partners. - Assist with implementing systems and processes to improve productivity. Personal Assistance - Assist with personal scheduling, appointments, and travel. - Coordinate family-related logistics, reservations, and personal arrangements as requested. - Handle personal administrative tasks, purchases, and other assigned responsibilities. - Help maintain organization between professional and personal commitments. Qualifications - Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or similar role. - Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail. - Strong time management and ability to handle multiple priorities. - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. - Professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. - Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and digital productivity tools. - Comfortable learning and using AI tools and project management software. - Flexibility to coordinate with U.S.-based teams when necessary. What We're Looking For We value someone who: - Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions. - Thinks ahead and anticipates what needs to be done. - Follows through consistently and pays attention to details. - Communicates clearly and professionally. - Enjoys creating organization out of complexity. - Is dependable, resourceful, and committed to continuous improvement. - Is interested in growing professionally alongside an expanding group of businesses. Growth Opportunity This position offers the opportunity to work directly with an entrepreneur and CEO overseeing multiple growing businesses. For the right individual, there is potential to develop into a more senior executive operations or Chief of Staff–type role as responsibilities and capabilities grow.

Job Summary We are looking for a Senior US IT Recruiter with strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment for U.S. clients. In this role, you will manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from sourcing and screening to negotiation and onboarding while leveraging AI-powered recruiting tools and market insights to improve efficiency, candidate experience, and placement success. This is an opportunity to work in a dynamic, growth-driven environment where you will contribute directly to ISoftech’s mission of delivering top IT talent to leading U.S. clients. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end recruitment cycle for U.S.-based clients, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding. Collaborate closely with recruiting leads, account managers, and hiring managers to fulfill client requirements. Utilize AI-enabled sourcing tools, resume parsers, and predictive hiring platforms to identify the right candidates quickly. Develop proactive hiring pipelines and talent pools for upcoming IT requirements. Source candidates from niche IT platforms (Dice, Monster, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.) and emerging AI-driven sourcing channels. Conduct technical screenings/interviews, document results, and provide hiring recommendations. Ensure compliance with U.S. hiring practices, labor laws, and visa regulations. Build strong candidate relationships to improve engagement and reduce dropouts. Stay updated with AI trends in recruitment, U.S. staffing market demands, and evolving tax/visa regulations. Contribute to strategic hiring initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support organizational growth. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any related field. Minimum 2 plus years of relevant experience in U.S. IT recruitment. Strong understanding of U.S. hiring practices, employment laws, and staffing models. Experience recruiting U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, and work visa holders (H1B, E3, TN, etc.). Familiarity with U.S. tax terms (W2, 1099, Corp-to-Corp) is essential. Familiarity with handling U.S. federal requirements is a strong plus Proficiency in sourcing IT talent across technologies (Java, .NET, Cloud, DevOps, Data, Cybersecurity, etc.). Strong candidate assessment skills with the ability to evaluate both technical and cultural fit. Willingness to learn and stay updated with emerging IT technologies is a must. Excellent oral and written communication skills; proficiency in English is required. Self-motivated, analytical thinker, and effective team player. Why Join ISoftech Inc.? Be part of a global IT staffing leader with a proven track record. Leverage the latest AI trends in hiring to enhance your recruiting career. Hybrid setup Attractive compensation, incentives, and employee perks. Opportunity to work with top-tier U.S. clients and cutting-edge IT talent. Location: Chennai Working Hours: 6:30 PM – 3:00 AM IST (Mon–Fri) Compensation & Perks: Attractive salary + commissions Cab service or travel allowance Onsite food and snacks Health insurance

review_candidates.description: Job Description: Job Objectives: To provide advanced support to the HR Manager across multiple HR functional areas including payroll, HR analytics, HR operations, employee relations, and continuous process improvement. The role plays a key part in driving operational excellence, ensuring data accuracy, improving HR processes, and supporting strategic HR initiatives. The position also serves as a key liaison between HR, employees, internal stakeholders, and external vendors to support the organization’s business goals and foster a positive employee experience. Job Responsibilities: Recruitment & On-boarding Take lead in overseeing the implementation of the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, and interviewing candidates (Only 2nd Interview for Job Bands below 6B). Coordinate and facilitate new employee onboarding to ensure a smooth transition and a positive on boarding experience that is a key driver of early engagement and productivity. Performance Management Assist with the company's performance appraisal process, ensuring a smooth and fair cycle. Internal Communications / Employee Engagement Serve as a point of contact for employee inquiries in a timely manner. Take lead when it comes to communication and implementation of HR policies and procedures to ensure compliance and alignment in the way HR operates. Plan and Implement engagement strategies that align with business culture and drive employee experience. Mobility Management Forecast, plan ahead and manage all aspects of Employment Pass applications (Including Dependent Passes) and other work visa processes. Responsible for ensuring work permit applications including renewal is in full compliance with local immigration laws, and working on tight deadlines to meet business needs. Off Boarding / Employee Exit Conduct exit interviews (Below Job Band 6B only) and analyze feedback to identify trends. Partner with HR Manager to propose, develop and implement Strategic Employee Retention plans to keep a healthy turnover rate. HR Systems Maintain and update employee data in BIPO with a high degree of accuracy. Generate regular and ad-hoc reports to support strategic decision-making. Training & Development Manage the company's annual training plan in alignment with business objectives and employee development needs, based on the annual One Airbus Training Plan. Track and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through feedback and data analysis. Maintain accurate training records and employee development logs. Responsible for preparing the Training Bond, ensuring it’s completely signed before Training commences and submitting it for Stamping. HRDC Claims Management Ensure the company's compliance with HRDC regulations and requirements. Manage the HRDC claims process (excluding applying for training grants via eTRiS system) Preparing and submitting all necessary documentation, such as invoices, attendance sheets, and training schedules Tracking and following up on the status of claims to ensure timely reimbursement. Maintain a comprehensive record of all HRDC-related activities and correspondence. Talent Management & Development: Support the administration of talent management initiatives, succession planning, and career pathing. Collaborate with managers to create individual development plans. Help maintain and update job descriptions Other HR Task Work closely with the HR Manager to strategically plan and execute projects, such as organizational development, workforce planning, and change management initiatives. Act as the primary point of contact for all HR-related matters in the HR Manager's absence, demonstrating the ability to make sound decisions and handle urgent issues with minimal supervision. Other duties reasonably determined from time to time by the Company. Job Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience as a HR Generalist Proficient in Google Suites & HR systems Strong knowledge of Malaysia labour laws, HRDC and HR best practices Proven experience in recruitment, training, employee engagement Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timeline Proven experience with Employment Pass and other immigration processes Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com . At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

review_candidates.description: Senior Electromechanical Engineer - Project Management & Coordination Location: Egypt Employment Type: Full-Time Industry: Oil & Gas, Petroleum Storage and Terminal Operations Experience: Minimum 10 Years About the Position We are seeking an experienced Senior Electromechanical Engineer with strong project management and coordination skills to join the owner's team for a major petroleum storage terminal development in Egypt. The role will initially focus on coordinating engineering consultants, monitoring design progress, resolving outstanding technical matters and preparing the project for execution. As the project advances, responsibilities will expand to procurement, supplier and contractor coordination, construction follow-up, testing and commissioning. Key Responsibilities Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering consultants across mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, civil and marine disciplines. Monitor engineering deliverables, resolve design interfaces and follow up on outstanding technical matters. Organize progress meetings, maintain action registers and report project status, risks and delays to management. Review technical specifications, scopes of work, tender documents and equipment requirements. Support technical bid evaluations, supplier selection, procurement and contract negotiations. Coordinate with equipment suppliers and contractors throughout procurement and execution. Monitor schedules, budgets, milestones and contractual obligations. Follow up on construction, installation, testing and commissioning activities. Ensure compliance with approved specifications, quality requirements and HSE standards. Support project handover and operational readiness. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience, including engineering coordination and project management. Proven experience in petroleum storage terminals, tank farms, oil and gas facilities or similar industrial projects. Strong technical knowledge of storage tanks, piping, pumps, firefighting, electrical systems, instrumentation and automation. Experience coordinating engineering consultants, suppliers and construction contractors. Experience with an owner's project team or Project Management Consultant (PMC) is an advantage. Knowledge of procurement, tender evaluation, contract administration and construction management. Proficiency in Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. PMP certification is an advantage. Good communication and reporting skills in English and Arabic. Willingness to undertake regular project site visits. Candidate Profile We are looking for a proactive, technically competent and well-organized professional who takes ownership of assignments, follows through on commitments and can effectively coordinate consultants, suppliers and contractors. The successful candidate should combine practical engineering experience with strong project management capabilities and be able to represent the owner's interests throughout the project. How to Apply Interested candidates should email their updated CV to: careers@fleetenergy.net Subject: Senior Electromechanical Engineer - Project Management Please highlight relevant project experience, previous responsibilities, current location and availability.
